meta.connection: Holding contact on the mat and noticing what contact does to you are the same skill. Both mean staying present when someone gets close, instead of pushing them away. The pin teaches your body to stay. Thinking about it teaches your mind why staying is hard.
meta.takeaway: Contact does something to all of us. Now you can feel yours.

slides.title: What happens in you when someone makes real contact?

items: Whoever connects first wins. The same rule applies to both players.
The top player wins by connecting his hands around the bottom player from the outside.
The bottom player wins by making the top player's butt hit the mat and sitting up.

body.text: Chest to Chest Under Elbows Maintenance

items: The top player holds as long as he keeps both elbows covered.
The bottom player wins by getting both elbows to touch his body, or by making the top player fall.
